title: objectql: `deleteBehavior` on a `user` field parses but the delete walk never reads it, so `restrict` / `cascade` on a user field are not enforced
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: ① out-of-scope finding of the #29062 dev (os-dev-report 6574609406, `out_of_scope_findings` class c; measured by the earlier #29062 card thread, report 6571331581), confirmed out of PR #29245's scope by the seat ACCEPT on that PR (the seat ruling kept the delete walk untouched). Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p2 · a declared constraint that silently does nothing.

Reach: any object that declares a `user` or multi-valued `user` field with `deleteBehavior: 'restrict'` or `'cascade'`, when the named user is deleted.
Reader who acts: the `domain:spec` lane if the answer is to refuse the key on `user` fields; a `domain:server` seat (`packages/objectql`) if the answer is to enforce it.

## What happens (measured by the #29062 card thread at `6b3ba82c`, not re-measured on this card)

- `deleteBehavior` is accepted on a `user` field and materializes, but `DELETE_SEMANTICS_REFERENCE_TYPES` in `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` lists only `master_detail`, `lookup` and `tree`. The delete walk never visits a `user` field.
- Probe rows on the showcase: a `user` / multi `user` field declared `restrict` did not block deleting the user; one declared `cascade` did not delete the referring row. Both kept the deleted user's id.
- PR #29245 (#29062) makes the leftover id harmless on later edits, but the declared behaviour is still not honoured.

## Wanted

Measure on `main` first. Then one of: (A) the spec refuses `deleteBehavior` on a `user` field (it cannot be honoured: user deletion goes through the auth layer, not the objectql delete walk), with an author-time message; or (B) the user-delete path runs the same walk for `user` fields. Report which the user-delete door can actually reach before choosing; #22957 (the `tree` twin, closed) is the precedent for B.

Dedupe: searched `deleteBehavior user field`, `user field deleteBehavior ignored`; nearest #22957 (tree, closed), #26718 (lookup restrict, closed). **New.**

Links back: #29062, PR #29245, #22957.
